nodes.title: Fixed positive physical scales
nodes.summary: Keep a, E_star, alpha/E_star and hbar fixed and positive.
nodes.detail: Homogeneous tau, finite-graph lambda and canonical q have different roles. A shared symbol does not identify their generators or physical clocks.

nodes.title: Initial homogeneous complete-block model
nodes.summary: Unbounded complete onsite blocks plus bounded finite-range stars; original M cap 35/1664.
nodes.detail: AE2 additionally restricts M<=1/1000. No finite spin cutoff replaces the physical onsite Hilbert spaces.

nodes.title: Physical 18-vertex, 33-link, 20-face graph
nodes.summary: Actual Gauss-invariant full-link model with physical finite retained subspace P293.
nodes.detail: AC holds on its stated coupling/input class. AF2 computation fixes lambda=0.01. The retained space is not the whole Hilbert space.

nodes.title: Canonical summable full-link family
nodes.summary: Original q-dependent spatial profile, stationary state and prescribed growing physical clock.
nodes.detail: This is not the homogeneous coupling model. Endpoint witnesses do not equate the families.

nodes.title: Homogeneous nonlinear iteration
nodes.summary: Prove the next actual source and changed-diagonal estimates in a useful interaction norm.
nodes.detail: Per-source operator contraction and a finite weighted decomposition do not establish weighted contraction, all-step convergence or a numerical homogeneous gap.

nodes.title: Larger physical graphs and matched limits
nodes.summary: Track complete new channels and constants when enlarging the physical graph.
nodes.detail: One fixed graph and one preparation class do not give volume-uniform estimates or a continuum trajectory.

nodes.title: Identifiable physical clock and observable map
nodes.summary: Determine which independent observables identify scale parameters and whether another model has a proved matching map.
nodes.detail: A null probe, an even scalar or an enormous-time mathematical witness cannot by itself calibrate a physical clock.

nodes.title: Nontrivial continuum Yang–Mills theory and mass gap
nodes.summary: Construct a matched nontrivial continuum theory with the required axioms and a positive physical mass gap.
nodes.detail: This remains unresolved. No network path supplies missing mathematical hypotheses.

nodes.title: AG · Control the first actual nonlinear homogeneous update
nodes.summary: Derive the generated source, scalar and diagonal update for one actual transformation. Prove a useful bound in the original rooted support-cardinality norm, with all translated crossings and domains; test whether the source-specific contraction improves the collective weighted budget.
nodes.detail: Choose only after AG1 review: either close the measured missing weighted estimate or replace the failed construction under a new explicit contract. Do not preclaim a full all-stage induction.
nodes.model: Homogeneous complete-block model; start inside AE2 restricted coupling range.

nodes.title: AH · Scale the physical graph with complete omitted-channel control
nodes.summary: Extend the retained-basis/channel construction to a predeclared next graph and compute how Gram, coupling, residual and denominator constants change. Establish exact channel completeness before reporting heat accuracy or trends with graph size.
nodes.detail: Choose from the first graph-scaling review: sharpen the dominant complete leakage bound or compare a held-out observable/input class with its own absolute and relative error conditions. A graph-size trend is not a volume-uniform theorem.
nodes.model: Actual Gauss-invariant finite-link SU(2) graphs at fixed physical scales.

nodes.title: AI · Make observable and physical-scale identification explicit
nodes.summary: Freeze actual Wilson observables, independent parameters and physical observation times; derive which parameter combinations their complete readouts identify, with null probes and indistinguishable parameter families as controls. State the extra measurement or mathematical map needed for homogeneous-model comparison.
nodes.detail: Select only after AI1 review: add a genuinely discriminating observable or test a precisely specified state/domain/generator matching relation with a bounded defect. Do not fit a clock to force model agreement.
nodes.model: Canonical summable family first; any cross-model comparison needs a declared map.
